parameters.description: Object type ID of the object type to rename.

delete.description: Clears the rename for the input object type, resetting its label back to the HubSpot-provided default.

post.description: Activates the object type, making it available across HubSpot. If the object type is already activated, this operation does nothing.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: Object type ID of the object type to activate.

results.description: Contains existing default and renamed labels for all renamed object types.

category.description: The error category, represented as a string.

context.description: An object providing context about the error condition, where each property is an array of strings.

correlationId.description: A unique identifier for the request, formatted as a UUID. This should be included with any error reports or support tickets.

errors.description: An array providing further information about the error, with each item being an ErrorDetail object.

links.description: A map of link names to associated URIs containing documentation about the error or recommended remediation steps, represented as an object with string properties.

message.description: A human-readable message describing the error along with remediation steps where appropriate. It is a string.

subCategory.description: A specific category that provides more detailed information about the error. It is a string.

Error.description: Represents an error response returned by the API when an operation fails. This component is used in various endpoints to provide detailed information about the error encountered.

example.message: Invalid input (details will vary based on the error)

code.description: The status code associated with the error detail. This is a string property.

context.description: Context about the error condition, represented as an object where each key is a context name and the value is an array of strings providing further details.

in.description: The name of the field or parameter in which the error was found. This is a string property.

message.description: A human readable message describing the error along with remediation steps where appropriate. It is a required string property.

subCategory.description: A specific category that contains more specific detail about the error. This is a string property.

ErrorDetail.description: Represents detailed information about an error that occurred in the API. This component is used to provide additional context and specifics about errors, typically as part of an error response.

enablement.description: A boolean indicating whether the object type is enabled (true) or not (false).

pluralLabel.description: A string representing the plural form of the label for the object type.

singularLabel.description: A string representing the singular form of the label for the object type.

objectTypeId.description: Object type ID of the object type that was renamed.

proposedPropertyLabelChangesByInternalNa.description: An object mapping each object type ID to another object, which maps internal property names to their proposed label changes. Each proposed label change is represented by a PropertyLabelChange object.

enablementByObjectTypeId.description: A map where each key is an object type ID and each value is a boolean indicating whether the object type is enabled (true) or disabled (false).

currentLabel.description: The existing label of the property, still referencing the pre-rename object label.

proposedLabel.description: The new proposed label for the property.
